title: Webhooks
description: Signed HTTPS callbacks when your sandboxes and operations change state.

notConfigured.title: Webhooks are not configured
notConfigured.description: This server has no DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY, so webhook endpoints cannot be created. Ask the operator to enable them.

empty.title: No webhook endpoints yet
empty.description: Add an endpoint to receive sandbox and operation events. Each delivery is signed; verify it with your endpoint's secret.

status.disabledByOwner: Disabled by you. Deliveries are not sent while it is disabled.
status.disabledForFailures: Disabled after sustained delivery failures (72 hours and 20 consecutive failures). Fix the receiver, then enable it again.

form.urlHint: HTTPS only. Private and internal addresses are refused unless the operator allowlisted them for your account.
form.kindsDefault: Lifecycle and commands (create, stop, kill, reconnect, lease renewal, run command)
form.kindsAll: All operation kinds (includes high-volume file and process reads)
form.eventsHint: Choose what to be told about. A group's box selects all of its events.

create.statusFailed: Couldn't check whether webhooks are set up on this server.
create.title: Add a webhook endpoint
create.description: Events that commit after the endpoint exists are delivered to it.
create.secretHint: Verify every delivery with this secret (Standard Webhooks). It is shown only now; store it with your receiver.
create.createdDescription: Store the signing secret with your receiver now. Once you confirm you saved it, the endpoint opens so you can send a test event.

edit.title: Edit endpoint
edit.description: Changes apply to deliveries attempted from now on.

rotate.title: Rotate the signing secret?
rotate.description: A new secret is generated and shown once. During the overlap, deliveries carry signatures from both secrets so your receiver can switch without dropping events.
rotate.overlap: Keep the old secret valid for

test.queued: Test event queued. It appears in the delivery log below.

delete.title: Delete the endpoint for {{host}}?
delete.description: The endpoint and its delivery log are deleted. Pending deliveries are dropped.
delete.typePrompt: Type the endpoint host to confirm

detail.notFound: This webhook endpoint does not exist or was deleted.

deliveries.title: Delivery log
deliveries.description: Deliveries are retried for 24 hours. Each attempt is signed again with a fresh timestamp; the webhook-id stays the same.

delivery.title: Delivery {{id}}
delivery.redelivered: Redelivery queued with the same webhook-id.

problem.destinationUnreachable: We can't deliver to this URL. Use an https:// address whose host resolves to a public address, on port 443 or 1024–65535, with no credentials or #fragment.
problem.destinationInvalid: That URL is not valid: use https://, no credentials or fragment, and port 443 or 1024-65535.
problem.destinationBlocked: That destination is not allowed: private, local and metadata addresses are refused.
problem.limit: You already have the maximum of 10 webhook endpoints.
problem.disabled: This endpoint is disabled. Enable it first.
problem.expired: This event is too old to redeliver.
problem.notConfigured: Webhooks are not configured on this server.
problem.notFound: It no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.generic: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
problem.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
problem.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
